en.purpose: To calculate and assess the BRI
en.use:
BRI = 364.2 - 365.5 × {1 − [(WC/2π)/(0.5 × H)]2}0.5

WC: waist circumference, m

H: height, m
en.misuse: Do not use in pediatric patients

other_details.en: The Body Roundness Index (BRI) is employed in routine health screenings to assess body shape and estimate body fat, identifying individuals at increased risk of obesity-related conditions and all-cause mortality.
